name: global-property-platform
description: Global property marketplace. Core marketplace only; the Advertising Platform is an owner-approval-gated future phase.

scripts.prepare:deps: npm run build -w @property-platform/shared-types && npm run build -w @property-platform/database
scripts.lint: npm run prepare:deps && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && eslint . --max-warnings=0
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run prepare:deps && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run prepare:deps && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run check:scope && npm run check:secrets && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
